# TripToCost

> TripToCost publishes complete, ready-to-go travel itineraries: day-by-day plans, culture guides, packing checklists, and insider tips for 103 destinations across the world. Every itinerary assumes Day 1 begins with airport arrival, states a real estimated budget upfront, and includes a "Need to Know" culture/etiquette section and a printable packing list.

## Site

- [Browse all destinations](https://www.triptocost.com/browse): filterable list of every itinerary by travel style, budget, and region
- [About TripToCost](https://www.triptocost.com/about): why the site exists and what it believes about trip planning
- [How It Works](https://www.triptocost.com/how-it-works): what's included in every itinerary guide
- [Saved Trips](https://www.triptocost.com/saved-trips): a visitor's bookmarked itineraries (stored locally in their browser only)
